class liiontr.library.reactions.VolumetricReactionParameters[source]

Bases: object

Reaction parameters reported using reactant content per cell volume.

This representation is intended for models where the literature reports an initial remaining reactant fraction.

LiionTR converts that quantity to an initial conversion using:

alpha_initial = 1 - remaining_fraction

__post_init__()[source]

Validate the volumetric reaction parameters.

Return type:

None

property initial_conversion: float

Return the initial conversion.

alpha = 1 - remaining_fraction

Hu et al. (2020)

Thermal runaway model parameters from Hu et al. (2020).

liiontr.library.hu2020.hu2020_sei_decomposition()[source]

Return the SEI decomposition parameters reported by Hu et al. (2020).

Original reported parameters

A:

1.667e15 1/s

Ea:

1.3508e5 J/mol

H:

257 J/g

Wc:

6.104e5 g/m3

Initial remaining fraction:

0.15

Reaction order:

1.0

LiionTR unit conversions

H:

257 J/g -> 257000 J/kg

Wc:

6.104e5 g/m3 -> 610.4 kg/m3

LiionTR uses conversion alpha, where:

alpha = 1 - remaining_fraction

Therefore:

alpha_initial = 1 - 0.15 = 0.85

Return type:

VolumetricReactionParameters

liiontr.library.hu2020.hu2020_anode_electrolyte()[source]

Return the anode-electrolyte reaction parameters reported by Hu et al. (2020).

Original reported parameters

A:

2.5e13 1/s

Ea:

1.3508e5 J/mol

H:

1714 J/g

Wc:

6.104e5 g/m3

Initial remaining fraction:

0.75

Reaction order:

1.0

LiionTR unit conversions

H:

1714 J/g -> 1.714e6 J/kg

Wc:

6.104e5 g/m3 -> 610.4 kg/m3

Initial conversion:

alpha_initial = 1 - 0.75 = 0.25

The SEI-dependent threshold and exponential inhibition are represented separately by hu2020_anode_progress_model().

Return type:

VolumetricReactionParameters

liiontr.library.hu2020.hu2020_anode_progress_model()[source]

Return the coupled progress model for the Hu 2020 anode-electrolyte reaction.

The base reaction follows:

f(alpha) = (1 - alpha)

and is inhibited by:

exp(-sei_thickness_ratio)

The reaction is active only when the remaining SEI fraction is below 0.10.

Return type:

ThresholdProgress

liiontr.library.hu2020.hu2020_initial_conversions()[source]

Return initial reaction conversions for the Hu 2020 network.

Reaction ordering:

0: SEI decomposition 1: Anode-electrolyte 2: Cathode decomposition 3: Electrolyte decomposition

Return type:

list[float]

cell (Cell)

Return type:

Return type:

float

liiontr.library.hu2020.hu2020_cathode_decomposition(cell)[source]

Build the Hu 2020 cathode decomposition reaction.

The cathode is represented by two parallel kinetic channels sharing a single reaction conversion alpha.

Both channels are active only at temperatures greater than or equal to 393.15 K.

Reported cathode content:

Wp = 1.221e6 g/m3

= 1221 kg/m3

Channel 1

A:

1.75e9 1/s

Ea:

1.1495e5 J/mol

H:

77 J/g = 77000 J/kg

Channel 2

A:

1.077e12 1/s

Ea:

1.5888e5 J/mol

H:

84 J/g = 84000 J/kg

Progress law

f(alpha) = alpha * (1 - alpha)

Parameters:

cell (Cell)

Return type:

MultiChannelReaction

liiontr.library.hu2020.hu2020_electrolyte_decomposition()[source]

Original reported parameters

We:

Initial remaining fraction:

1.0

Reaction order:

1.0

LiionTR unit conversions

Initial conversion:

The temperature threshold is applied separately by hu2020_electrolyte_reaction().

Return type:

VolumetricReactionParameters
